## Scope

The audit covered 220 second reads taken during the quarter. It assessed the consistency between first and second grades and reviewed the overall level of agreement across the audited sets. The purpose was to provide a clear summary of grading quality and identify any issues requiring follow-up.

The review was limited to the reads included in the audit. Results should therefore be considered in the context of the material examined and are not a statement about work outside the audit sample.

## Result

First and second grades agreed in 60.9 per cent of sets. This is the overall agreement result for the audit and provides the main measure of consistency between the two grades.

Per-grader results are recorded in the attached spreadsheet. These results are discussed with each grader privately, allowing any relevant points to be considered directly and supporting appropriate follow-up.
